note: After the English original description of Haviland 1898 (published as Termes planus n. sp., later placed in Termitogeton). It describes the alate (male), the queen (female) and the soldier; the measurements are single values. The OCR readings °8 mm, 4°5, 1:5 and 7 mm were restored from the context as 0.8, 4.5, 1.5 and 0.7 mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Originally published as the new species Termes planus (later the type species of Termitogeton planus). Alate body very flat, chestnut brown above and yellowish brown below, body length 3 mm; head width 0.8 mm, nearly triangular, hairy; pronotum small, about half as broad as the head, with a forward-directed spine in the middle of the anterior margin, the posterior margin evenly convex; soldier head heart-shaped, very flat, length 1 mm, width 1.2 mm, without a fontanelle, the mandibular cutting edge without teeth.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Male body length 3 mm, very flat, chestnut brown (castaneous) above, yellowish brown below. Head width 0.8 mm, nearly triangular, hairy. Fontanelle indistinct, near the broad vertex. Ocelli one ocellus diameter from the small compound eyes. Antennae 15 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 3, the remaining segments slightly thickened towards the apex. The base of the labrum does not project. Pronotum small, about half as broad as the head, with a forward-directed spine in the middle of the anterior margin, the posterior margin evenly convex. Posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum straight, hardly lobed. Fore-wing scale larger than the hind-wing scale, but the two not overlapping. Wing length 4.5 mm, width 1.5 mm, hairy, pale brownish grey (uliginous); costa and subcosta developed; media not visible; submedia slender, with 6 or 7 branches. Hind legs reaching abdominal segment 7. Abdominal papillae absent. Female (queen) body length 6 mm, abdomen very flat; lateral membranes with long hairs and without pigment spots.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body length 4 mm. Head length 1 mm, width 1.2 mm, heart-shaped, very flat, ochre yellow, hairy; fontanelle absent. Antennae 14 segments, segment 3 very short, segment 2 longer than segment 4. Labrum lanceolate, acute, reaching almost to the tip of the mandibles. Mandibles 0.7 mm long, the tips slightly incurved, the cutting edge without teeth. Postmentum narrow at the base, distinctly widening towards the apex. Pronotum about half as broad as the head.
